College Football Roundup: Utah, Washington State, James Madison, Panthers Win

In college football action, No. 17 Utah defeated Utah State 33-0 with two touchdown passes from Devon Dampier and a touchdown run by Daniel Bray. Washington State secured their first win, beating Duquesne 48-7, with Caden Pinnick throwing two touchdown passes and running for another. James Madison topped San Diego State 26-13, as Coleman threw two touchdown passes. The Panthers dominated a short-handed Falcons team 34-3, with Young throwing three touchdown passes, two of which went to Waller.
